_comment: Widget repair v3 mapping for task t_bc12159c. Maps each resolved widget issue to source, fix, and verification.

widget_fixes.expected: Catalog widget floats absolutely on overview; does not cover built-in CSS Grid cards
widget_fixes.observed: At x=0,y=0 covering collective-wallet KPI card and all subsequent grid cards
widget_fixes.source: applyWidgetStyle unconditionally set position:absolute on ALL widgets in view mode
widget_fixes.fix: applyWidgetStyle now only applies position:absolute to catalog widgets (st.type==='catalog') in view mode. Non-catalog cards stay in CSS Grid flow.

widget_fixes.expected: Heatmap grid card visible in CSS Grid flow on overview tab
widget_fixes.observed: Hidden behind live-market-tick catalog widget at overlapping x=0,y=0 position
widget_fixes.source: Same root cause: applyWidgetStyle on non-catalog grid cards forced absolute positioning
widget_fixes.fix: Non-catalog grid cards in view mode keep CSS Grid flow. Only catalog widgets float absolutely.

widget_fixes.expected: Edit mode does not trigger widget refresh/overlay; interval stops during edit and resumes after
widget_fixes.observed: 8-second mini-market timer fired during editing; interval not restarted after cancel/save
widget_fixes.source: setInterval at line 2127 lacked EDITING check; enterEdit cleared interval but cancelEdit/saveLayout did not restart it
widget_fixes.fix: Added !EDITING guard to mini-market timer. cancelEdit and saveLayout now restart the interval.

test_suite.note: 4 errors are pre-existing Playwright pointer-interception issues in test environment
